facts.fact: Applying on the National Scholarship Portal has no application fee: it is completely free of cost
facts.quote: No, application on the National Scholarship Portal is completely free of cost.
facts.note: Answer to Q34 'Is there any fee to apply for this scholarship?' in the Department of Higher Education's CSSS FAQ hosted on scholarships.gov.in.

facts.fact: The student can apply herself: she first generates her One Time Registration (OTR) through NSP's OTR Registration on scholarships.gov.in
facts.quote: One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory to avail scholarships. It is a unique number allotted to the candidate for the entire academic career and can be generated through National Scholarship Portal OTR Registration .

facts.fact: If she uses a Common Service Centre (CSC), the total charge for the whole activity (OTR generation, biometric authentication and filling the complete application) is fixed at Rs 30, inclusive of taxes
facts.quote: The total charges for the entire activity per candidate (including generation of Reference number, biometric -authentication, generation of One-Time Registration (OTR) number, and filing of complete application form of the candidate) is fixed at Rs 30.00 (inclusive of all applicable taxes, etc.)

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish; says applying on NSP has no fee and that at a CSC the official charge for OTR plus the full application is Rs 30; explains the student can apply herself through One Time Registration on scholarships.gov.in; warns about overcharging without blaming the user, citing NSP.
fail_if: Says Rs 500 (or any amount above the official Rs 30 CSC charge) is a valid fee; says NSP charges an application fee; cites a third-party site.
summary: No NSP fee and OTR self-application confirmed; added NSP's notice that CSCs charge a fixed Rs 30 for OTR plus the full application.
